data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, the name Latika is derived from the word 'Lat' meaning 'dance' and 'ka' meaning 'girl'. This name symbolizes the grace and beauty of a dancing girl, often associated with the Hindu goddesses Radha and Parvati. The name Latika carries the meaning “Dancing Girl” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Latika usually hope their child will grow to embody dancing girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.
